display.purpose: Hero headlines and the closing CTA. Baloo 2 800, uppercase. One per fold.

body.purpose: Paragraphs, leads, names, meta. Space Mono. Keep measure under ~45ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase kickers, badges, sticker tags. Baloo 2 800, tracking 0.14em.

shadows.name: sticker
shadows.purpose: Default hard offset shadow for cards, steps, notes, color bands. Zero blur.

shadows.name: sticker-lg
shadows.purpose: Heroes, CTA, spotlight, and the hover/lift state of any card.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default ease-out for hovers, presses, reveals.

motion.name: lift
motion.value: translate(-3px,-3px) + shadow grow to sticker-lg on :hover

motion.name: float
motion.value: gsap y:-18 + rotation wobble, sine.inOut yoyo infinite
motion.purpose: Doodles and note stickers idle motion.

motion.name: marquee
motion.value: translateX(0 -> -50%) linear infinite, pause on hover

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: gsap from y:44 opacity:0, ScrollTrigger top 86%

extensions.reducedMotion: All float / twinkle / marquee / reveal / wordmark animation collapses to a static, fully-legible state under prefers-reduced-motion. Non-negotiable.

narrative.northStar: Le carnet de stickers (The Sticker Scrapbook)
narrative.overview: Joyful neo-brutalism for a birthday product. Every element is a hand-cut sticker: thick black ink outlines, a hard un-blurred offset shadow as if peeled and pressed onto the page, a slight playful tilt, and a riot of festive color. Big rounded chunky Baloo 2 type shouts; a mono body speaks; floating SVG doodles and a friendly mascot carry the joy. Color is voice: violet drenches heroes, a full festive palette color-blocks the page. Surfaces are flat and graphic, never glassy or gradient-y. Motion is everywhere but soft, and collapses entirely under reduced-motion.
keyCharacteristics: Baloo 2 800 display over Space Mono body
Full festive palette, color-blocked per section
Playful tilts, marker-highlighted words, animated SVG doodles, a mascot

rules.name: The Color-Block Rule
rules.body: Sections own a color: large saturated fields, not timid accents.

rules.name: The Text-On-Color Rule
rules.body: Yellow/lime/orange/paper take ink text; violet/magenta/blue/ink take paper text. Never light-on-light.

rules.name: The Round-Shouts-Mono-Speaks Rule
rules.body: Baloo 2 for joyful/loud (headings, labels, buttons); Space Mono for things being read (body, names, meta).

rules.name: The Marker Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is one tilted highlight box per headline, never two.

rules.name: The Hard Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are solid color, zero blur, fixed offset, always ink. Blurred shadows are forbidden.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: Interactive elements move with their shadow: buttons press in on click, cards lift on hover.

dos: Do outline everything with a 3px ink border and lift it with a hard offset shadow (8px 8px 0 ink).
Do color-block by section; let one saturated color own a fold.
Do set headings/labels/buttons in Baloo 2 800 and body/meta in Space Mono.
Do emphasize with a single tilted marker highlight per headline.
Do give cards/badges a small static tilt and straighten on hover; press buttons in on click.
Do decorate with animated hand-drawn SVG doodles, recolored per section.
Do keep neutrals tinted toward violet (Ink, Paper).
Do collapse all motion under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't use blurred / ambient shadows. Solid, zero-blur, ink only.
Don't use glassmorphism, purple-to-blue gradients, neon-on-dark, or gradient text.
Don't ship thin/timid borders or radius:0 sharp corners (that is legacy classic Sable).
Don't use pure #000 or #fff; always the tinted Ink/Paper.
Don't put light text on yellow/lime/paper, or color text on a same-color field.
Don't use emoji in the UI; use SVG doodles, the mascot, and lucide icons.
Don't set body copy in Baloo 2 or a hero in mono.
Don't force the new theme on users: ship it as an opt-in [data-theme] toggle with a way back.
